reviewer: json_scope, independent of root integration implementation
scope: Static engineering review of new root runtime-profile, compatibility and aggregate-evidence integration only; fresh aggregate/runtime acceptance is separate.
observations: Runtime profile validates exact WAR and selected renderer/JSON/ImageIO hashes during load and immediately before launch.
Compatibility preserves guarded source recipes and snapshots with explicit NO-ORACLE/NO-JPEG2000 and selected variant map; no test-compile suppression added.
Aggregate inspection checks source outputs, guarded class bytes, web.xml, frozen helper identity and exact replacement map before successful evidence.
JSON inspect_artifacts correctly receives metadata mappings, derives component receipt via verified source_evidence, reopens actual WAR and rejects a false nested report.
limitations: The review is not legal/license approval or evidence that unexecuted aggregate/runtime checks passed.
